name: Customer message handoff review - safe sample

parameters.content:
## Safe sample
Uses fictional customer messages, no credentials, and no external actions. Treat this as a routing example only: keep a person responsible for sensitive, urgent, disputed, or explicitly requested human conversations.

assignments.name: nextStep
assignments.value: Pause automated replies and place the full conversation in a named person's review queue.

assignments.name: nextStep
assignments.value: Draft a direct answer from approved sources, then apply the normal confidence and handoff checks before sending.
